caption_draft:
These 6 AI tools turn one prompt into a working app, and each has a free plan.

v0 — https://v0.app/pricing — 7 free messages a day
Bolt — https://bolt.new/pricing — 1M free tokens a month
Lovable — https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/plans-and-credits — 5 free build credits a day
Replit Agent — https://docs.replit.com/billing/plans/starter-plan — 1 free published app
Google AI Studio — https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/aistudio-build-mode — Builds an app from one prompt
Base44 — https://base44.com/pricing — 25 free message credits a month

Save this for the weekend and send it to the friend who has an app idea but has not started.

#ai #nocode #appdevelopment #v0 #bolt #lovable #replit #firstyear #notyourcollege
